lsp.query: Ich pflichte dem Kollegen Varela voll bei, wenn er davon spricht, dass die Auswirkungen der Globalisierung in jedem konkreten Fall unterschiedlich sind: Während sie für viele eine Herausforderung bildet, die eine Quelle von Reichtum und Chancen sein kann, ist sie für diejenigen, die sich an die tiefgreifenden Veränderungen nicht anzupassen wissen oder dazu nicht in der Lage sind, auch eine Quelle von Problemen und Unzulänglichkeiten.
lsp.judge: I fully agree with my colleague Varela when he talks about the fact that the effects of globalization are different in each specific case: while it can be a challenge that can be a source of wealth and opportunities for many, it can also be a source of problems and inadequacies for those who do not know how to adapt or are unable to adapt to the profound changes.
lsp.proxy: I fully agree with my colleague Varela when he says that the effects of globalization vary in each specific case: While it can be a challenge for many, a source of wealth and opportunities, it can also be a source of problems and deficiencies for those who are unable or unwilling to adapt to the profound changes.
lsp.reference: I fully agree with my colleague Varela when he says that the effects of globalization are different in each concrete case: While it can be a challenge for many, a source of wealth and opportunities, it is also a source of problems and deficiencies for those who do not know or are not able to adapt to the deep changes.

lsp.query: Dann einen Fischereisektor schaffen, der nachhaltig wirtschaftet, aber auch wirtschaftlich lebensfähig und international konkurrenzfähig ist - dabei sollten wir aber auch gleichzeitig denen helfen, die sich nach einer anderen Arbeit umsehen müssen -, eine moderne Fischereiaußenpolitik in enger Abstimmung mit den anderen Gemeinschaftspolitiken entwickeln, um eine verantwortungsbewusste und rationelle Bewirtschaftung der Ressourcen zu erreichen, und vor allem die Mittelmeerdimension neu entwickeln.
lsp.judge: Then create a fishing sector that operates sustainably, but is also economically viable and internationally competitive - while at the same time helping those who need to look for other work - develop a modern fisheries foreign policy in close coordination with other community policies to achieve responsible and rational resource management, and above all, redevelop the Mediterranean dimension.
lsp.proxy: Then create a fishing sector that is economically sustainable but also viable and competitive on an international level – at the same time, we should also help those who need to look for other types of work – develop a modern fisheries foreign policy in close coordination with other community policies to achieve responsible and rational resource management, and especially revitalize the Mediterranean dimension.
lsp.reference: Then create a fishing sector that is economically sustainable, but also economically viable and internationally competitive - while we should also help those who need to look for another job at the same time - develop a modern fishing external policy in close coordination with the other Community policies to achieve responsible and rational management of resources, and above all develop the Mediterranean dimension anew.

lsp.query: Auf unserer Reise durch dieses noch junge Land fanden wir all dies bestätigt: die wachsende Armut und die Schwierigkeiten im Gesundheits- und Bildungswesen, aber auch einige sich abzeichnende Chancen, die Initiativen im Ergebnis der Zusammenarbeit, die in den verschiedensten Bereichen sowohl in staatlicher Verantwortung oder von den NRO durchgeführt werden, die gewinnbringende Nutzung - wenn auch in begrenztem Umfang - von Kleinstkrediten, die Rolle und die besonders schwierige Lage der Frauen.
lsp.judge: On our journey through this young country, we found all of this confirmed: the growing poverty and the difficulties in the health and education sectors, but also some emerging opportunities, the initiatives resulting from cooperation, which are carried out in various fields both in state responsibility or by NGOs, the profitable use - albeit to a limited extent - of microcredits, the role and the particularly difficult situation of women.

lsp.query: Bangladesch hat Voraussetzungen, die viele andere Entwicklungsländer nicht haben, da das Land - und das halte ich für sehr wichtig - nur eine Sprache und eine Religion hat und nur aus einem Stamm besteht, was bedeutet, dass hier die ethnischen Konflikte nicht existieren, die wir z. B. in Afrika erleben, auch nicht die Religionskriege.
lsp.judge: Bangladesh has conditions that many other developing countries do not have, as the country - and I consider this very important - has only one language and one religion and consists of only one tribe, which means that the ethnic conflicts that we experience, for example, in Africa do not exist here, nor do the religious wars.
lsp.proxy: Bangladesh has conditions that many other developing countries lack, as the country – and I consider this very important – has only one language and one religion and consists of only one ethnic group, which means that ethnic conflicts, which we experience, for example, in Africa, do not exist here, nor do religious wars.

lsp.query: Dabei haben Bangladesch und die anderen Länder in dieser Kategorie die Chance, sich nicht als schwerkranker Patient zu präsentieren, der vom Rest der Welt neugierig betrachtet wird, sondern als Partner in einer globalen Gesellschaft mit Kulturen und Potenzialen, die für die Aufrechterhaltung der Vielfalt der Globalisierung wichtig sind.
lsp.judge: In this regard, Bangladesh and the other countries in this category have the opportunity to present themselves not as a critically ill patient being curiously observed by the rest of the world, but as partners in a global society with cultures and potentials that are important for maintaining the diversity of globalization.
lsp.proxy: In doing so, Bangladesh and the other countries in this category have the chance not to present themselves as sick patients scrutinized curiously by the rest of the world, but as partners in a global society with cultures and potentials that are crucial for maintaining the diversity of globalization.
lsp.reference: In this regard, Bangladesh and the other countries in this category have the opportunity not to present themselves as a sick patient who is curiously observed by the rest of the world, but as partners in a global society with cultures and potentials that are important for the preservation of the diversity of globalization.

lsp.query: Die zentrale Frage, die sich uns stellt, besteht in einer genauen Untersuchung, ob es einen Zusammenhang zwischen dem Einsatz dieser Munition und den von den Truppen oder von den Personen, die auf dem Balkan in Friedensmissionen tätig waren, gemeldeten Erkrankungen gibt oder ob sich im Gegenteil diese Krankheitserscheinungen nicht von denen unterscheiden, die man bei unseren Soldaten im Allgemeinen feststellt.
lsp.judge: The central question that confronts us is a precise examination of whether there is a connection between the use of this ammunition and the illnesses reported by the troops or by the individuals who were involved in peace missions on the Balkans, or whether, on the contrary, these disease manifestations do not differ from those observed in our soldiers in general.
lsp.proxy: The central question that arises for us concerns a precise investigation into whether there is a connection between the use of this ammunition and the illnesses reported by the troops or by the individuals who were active on the Balkan in peace missions, or whether, on the contrary, these disease manifestations do not differ from those that we generally observe in our soldiers.
lsp.reference: The central question that we face is a careful examination of whether there is a connection between the use of this ammunition and the illnesses reported by the troops or by the persons who were on the Balkan in peace missions, or whether, on the contrary, these disease manifestations do not differ from those that we find in our soldiers in general.

lsp.query: Einige Tage später, genauer gesagt am 5. Mai 1999, habe ich, zusammen mit elf weiteren Kollegen, einen Brief an Herrn Solana, den damaligen NATO-Generalsekretär, geschickt, weil wir vom Einsatz dieses Waffentyps wussten und weil wir ihn um einen Verwendungsstopp bitten wollten, da es sich hierbei um Waffen handelt, die in der Folge zu Gesundheitsproblemen bei der Bevölkerung und den Angehörigen der Streitkräfte führen können, ganz zu schweigen von der irreversiblen Umweltverseuchung.
lsp.judge: A few days later, to be precise on May 5, 1999, I, together with eleven other colleagues, sent a letter to Mr. Solana, the then NATO Secretary-General, because we knew about the use of this type of weapon and because we wanted to ask him to stop its use, as these are weapons that can lead to health problems for the population and members of the armed forces, not to mention irreversible environmental pollution.

lsp.query: Hier haben wir es aber mit einer 4 000-mal höheren Konzentration zu tun, so dass es vollkommen absurd ist, eine derartige Munition zu verwenden, die in die Umwelt gelangt und zum Entstehen von unlöslichen Partikeln führt, welche in die Atemwege und in den Magen-Darm-Trakt gelangen, und dann zu behaupten, das Vorhandensein eines Problems müsse erst bewiesen werden.
lsp.judge: Here, however, we are dealing with a concentration that is 4,000 times higher, so it is completely absurd to use such ammunition that enters the environment and leads to the formation of insoluble particles that enter the respiratory tract and the gastrointestinal tract, and then to claim that the existence of a problem must first be proven.

lsp.query: Die Forderung nach Wahrheit über die Vergangenheit und Transparenz für die Zukunft ist heute unvermeidbar, wie Sie selbst gesagt haben. Aber offen gesagt können von diesem Standpunkt aus meines Erachtens weder die Fünfzehn noch die NATO die Sache als erledigt betrachten, wenn man Ihre soeben gehörten Äußerungen berücksichtigt.
lsp.judge: The demand for truth about the past and transparency for the future is inevitable today, as you yourself have said. But frankly, from this standpoint, neither the Fifteen nor NATO can consider the matter settled, if one takes into account your statements just heard.

lsp.query: Frau Präsidentin, verehrte Kolleginnen und Kollegen! 1950, ich war damals 20 Jahre alt, wurde in der ganzen Welt, auch in Europa, an unseren Universitäten, an den Schulen - sie versuchten sogar, in die Kirchen einzudringen, was ihnen allerdings nicht gelang - eine Kampagne ausgelöst, und zwar die Kampagne gegen Ridgway, den so genannten "Pest-General ".
lsp.judge: Madam President, esteemed colleagues! In 1950, when I was 20 years old, a campaign was launched around the world, including in Europe, at our universities, at schools - they even tried to infiltrate the churches, but they did not succeed - and it was a campaign against Ridgway, the so-called "plague general."

lsp.query: Ihr, Genossen Kommunisten und Sozialisten, die Ihr damals in den wichtigen Zeiten, 1950 bis 1953, Stalins Friedenspreis bekamt, wobei es hier und da einige zitternde Papstanhänger gab, würdet Ihr uns bitte einen Moment mit Euren nachträglichen Moralpredigten, mit Euren ständigen Forderungen nach Rechenschaft verschonen?
lsp.judge: You, comrades Communists and Socialists, who received Stalin's Peace Prize in those important times, 1950 to 1953, where there were some trembling papal supporters here and there, would you please spare us a moment with your belated moral sermons, with your constant demands for accountability?
lsp.proxy: You, comrades Communists and Socialists, who received Stalin's Peace Prize back then during the important years from 1950 to 1953, when there were occasionally some quivering papal lackeys, would you please spare us for a moment your post-hoc moral sermons and your constant demands for accountability?

lsp.query: Herr Präsident, wir behandeln heute ein äußerst wichtiges Thema, auf das eigentlich sehr viel Zeit verwendet und zu dem sehr eingehende Überlegungen angestellt werden müssten, während wir es allerdings voller Emotionen angehen, die der Politik, zu der wir doch hier als Nichtfachleute gehalten sind, schlecht zu Gesicht stehen.
lsp.judge: Mr. President, we are dealing with an extremely important topic today, which should actually be given a lot of time and very thorough consideration, but we are approaching it with full emotions, which do not look good for the politics to which we are held here as non-experts.

lsp.query: Es geht darum - und da gebe ich dem Hohen Vertreter der GASP vollkommen Recht -, mit absoluter Sorgfalt und Genauigkeit zu untersuchen, ob ein Zusammenhang zwischen den aufgetretenen Krankheitsfällen und den Mengen von Munition mit so genanntem abgereichertem Uran besteht, die während des Krieges in Jugoslawien und im Kosovo, aber auch in Bosnien abgeworfen wurden.
lsp.judge: It is about - and I fully agree with the High Representative for CFSP on this point - examining with absolute care and precision whether there is a connection between the cases of illness that have occurred and the quantities of ammunition containing so-called depleted uranium that were dropped during the war in Yugoslavia and Kosovo, but also in Bosnia.

lsp.query: Daher hätten wir eine umfassendere Finanzierung gewünscht, eine stärkere Koordinierung zur höheren Wirksamkeit der verschiedenen Programme, die angewendet werden können, sowie eine stärkere Mitverantwortung im Hinblick auf die spätere - manchmal leider notwendige - militärische Intervention, die möglicherweise nicht erforderlich wäre, wenn die vorangehenden Phasen realisiert würden.

lsp.query: Nordkorea hat Mühe, die wenigen und ohnehin symbolhaften Verpflichtungen, die es auf militärischem Gebiet übernommen hat, einzuhalten; es verzögert die Zusammenführung der seit dem Krieg in den 50er Jahren getrennten Familien und lässt durch nichts seinen Willen erkennen, den Gegenbesuch von Kim Jong Il in Seoul, der für das kommende Frühjahr vorgesehen war und von dem noch nicht bekannt ist, wann und ob er stattfinden wird, auch wirklich in die Tat umzusetzen.
lsp.judge: North Korea is having difficulty fulfilling the few and symbolic commitments it has made in the military field; it is delaying the reunification of families separated since the war in the 1950s and showing no indication of its willingness to actually implement the reciprocal visit of Kim Jong Il to Seoul, which was scheduled for the coming spring but for which it is not yet known when or whether it will take place.
lsp.proxy: North Korea struggles to fulfill even the few, and anyway symbolic, military obligations it has taken on; it delays the reunification of families separated since the war in the 1950s and shows no willingness to follow through with Kim Jong Il's planned reciprocal visit to Seoul, which was scheduled for the coming spring and whose timing and whether it will take place are still unknown.

lsp.query: Deshalb sage ich: Selbstverständlich fördern wir die Annäherung zwischen den beiden koreanischen Staaten, selbstverständlich unterstützen wir die Nordkoreaner, damit sie nicht hungers sterben - der Kollege Ford hat soeben davon gesprochen -, doch stellen wir hierfür harte Bedingungen, um zu gewährleisten, dass die Hilfe auch bei denjenigen, die sie wirklich benötigen, ankommt und wir nicht ein paranoides und unberechenbares Regime unterstützen, das daran gewöhnt ist, uns mit Nuklearwaffen und Raketen zu erpressen, um sein Überleben zu sichern.
lsp.judge: Therefore, I say: Of course, we promote the rapprochement between the two Korean states, of course, we support the North Koreans so that they do not starve to death - Mr. Ford just spoke about it - but we set tough conditions to ensure that the aid reaches those who really need it and we do not support a paranoid and unpredictable regime that is accustomed to blackmailing us with nuclear weapons and missiles to secure its survival.

lsp.query: Wenn es lediglich darum gegangen wäre, zu überwachen, dass die EU-Mittel nicht zur Finanzierung von Projekten verwendet werden, die zur Zerstörung dieser besonderen Ökosysteme beitragen, so hätte ich diesen Text akzeptiert und dafür gestimmt, aber es ist inakzeptabel und beispiellos, dass eine Unionspolitik von der Einhaltung einer anderen abhängig gemacht wird und dass ein Umweltkriterium beispielsweise gegenüber einem sozialen Kriterium Vorrang haben soll.
lsp.judge: If it had only been about monitoring that EU funds are not used to finance projects that contribute to the destruction of these special ecosystems, I would have accepted this text and voted for it, but it is unacceptable and unprecedented that one Union policy is made dependent on the compliance with another and that an environmental criterion, for example, should take precedence over a social criterion.

lsp.query: Daraus geht eindeutig hervor, zu wessen Gunsten hier die "Engpässe in der Infrastruktur ", insbesondere in den "Verkehrs- und Energieinfrastrukturen " beseitigt, das "Finanzsystem effizient " gestaltet oder "transparente und demokratische institutionelle Rahmenbedingungen " geschaffen werden sollen, ein Euphemismus, mit dem man sich angesichts der allgegenwärtigen Korruption gegen sämtliche Beeinträchtigungen der westlichen Investoren wendet.
lsp.judge: It is clear from this that the "bottlenecks in the infrastructure," particularly in the "transport and energy infrastructures," are to be eliminated in favor of whom, the "financial system is to be made efficient," or "transparent and democratic institutional framework conditions" are to be created, a euphemism that addresses all the hindrances to Western investors in the face of the omnipresent corruption.
lsp.proxy: It is clear that the removal of "constraints in infrastructure," particularly in "transport and energy infrastructure," the "efficient shaping of the financial system," or the creation of "transparent and democratic institutional frameworks" is intended for the benefit of someone, an euphemism used to shield against all disruptions to Western investors in the face of pervasive corruption.

lsp.query: (FR) Da ein schnelles Eingreifen von Polizeikräften ebenso wie ein Krieg die Fortsetzung der Politik mit anderen Mittel darstellt und da wir der Politik der Europäischen Union nicht mehr als der Politik der Mitgliedstaaten vertrauen, sind wir gegen jegliche Form der militärischen oder polizeilichen Intervention der Europäischen Union, an welchem Ort auch immer.
lsp.judge: (FR) Since a rapid intervention by police forces is just as much a continuation of politics by other means as war, and since we do not trust the politics of the European Union any more than the politics of the member states, we are against any form of military or police intervention by the European Union, wherever it may be.
lsp.proxy: (BR) Since quick intervention by police forces, as well as war, represents the continuation of politics by other means, and since we no longer trust the politics of the European Union more than that of its member states, we are against any form of military or police intervention by the European Union, wherever it may occur.
lsp.reference: (FR) As a quick intervention by police forces, as well as a war, represents the continuation of policy by other means, and as we no longer trust the policy of the European Union more than that of the Member States, we are against any form of military or police intervention by the European Union, wherever it may be.

lsp.judge: The original impression was further reinforced by the formulation of the triggers of the special facility: Although it was outlined with high goals, it does not reveal what it practically consists of, whereas it would have been sufficient, while respecting the intervention areas regularly provided for by the Community regulations, to point to those that, mindful of the requirement for speed, set the reaction instrument in motion.

lsp.query: Nun befinden sich die Landwirtschaft und der ländliche Raum ja bekanntlich im Niedergang, wozu die gemeinsame Agrarpolitik entscheidend beigetragen hat, denn sie fördert die Konzentration der Flächen, die Intensivierung der Produktion, die zunehmende vertikale Organisation der landwirtschaftlichen Erzeugung, was zur Verödung und Entvölkerung der ländlichen Regionen führt, wie der Rückgang der Arbeitsplätze und der Betriebe um annähernd 22 % beziehungsweise 20 % seit 1990 beweist.
lsp.judge: Now, agriculture and the rural area are, of course, in decline, to which the common agricultural policy has made a decisive contribution, as it promotes the concentration of land, the intensification of production, and the increasing vertical organization of agricultural production, which leads to the desolation and depopulation of rural regions, as evidenced by the decline in jobs and businesses by approximately 22% and 20%, respectively, since 1990.
lsp.proxy: Agriculture and rural areas are indeed in decline, a process significantly accelerated by the common agricultural policy, as it promotes the concentration of land, the intensification of production, and the increasing vertical organization of agricultural production, leading to the depopulation and deindustrialization of rural regions, as the decline in jobs and businesses by approximately 22% and 20% respectively since 1990 attests.
lsp.reference: Now, agriculture and rural areas are well known to be in decline, which the common agricultural policy has contributed to decisively, as it promotes the concentration of land, the intensification of production, the increasing vertical organization of agricultural production, which leads to the depopulation and depopulation of rural regions, as the decline in jobs and businesses by almost 22% or 20% since 1990 proves.

lsp.proxy: Mr. President, although I voted for this report on the Common Fisheries Policy, I urge the European Parliament, the Council, and the Commission to pay more attention to and monitor an aspect that is mentioned under point 20 of the report but has been overlooked, namely how, or even if at all, pension amounts, levels, and conditions in the fisheries sector, and particularly among pensioners in the artisanal fishing sector, are controlled.
lsp.reference: Mr. President, I voted for this report on the Common Fisheries Policy, but I call on the European Parliament, the Council and the Commission to pay more attention to and monitor the aspect mentioned under point 20 of the report, which has been forgotten, namely how and whether pension amounts, levels and conditions in the fishing sector, and in particular in the artisanal fishing sector, are controlled.

lsp.query: Die Kommission führt folgende Prioritäten auf: verbesserte Kohärenz zwischen den verschiedenen Zielen, die die GFP verfolgt, insbesondere zwischen Erhaltung der Ressourcen, Wirtschaftlichkeit und Arbeitsplatzsicherung in den von der Fischerei abhängigen Gebieten; stärkere Berücksichtigung der wirtschaftlichen Dimension des Fischereisektors; verbesserte Integration der Umwelt- und Fischereipolitik; Verbesserung der Bewirtschaftungsinstrumente, wie insbesondere die Einbeziehung der mehrjährigen Bewirtschaftungsziele; ein übersichtlicherer Entscheidungsfindungsprozess und die Erhaltung der externen Dimension der GFP.
lsp.judge: The Commission lists the following priorities: improved coherence between the various objectives pursued by the CFP, particularly between the conservation of resources, economic viability, and job security in areas dependent on fishing; greater consideration of the economic dimension of the fisheries sector; improved integration of environmental and fisheries policies; improvement of management instruments, such as the inclusion of multi-annual management objectives; a more transparent decision-making process, and the preservation of the external dimension of the CFP.
lsp.proxy: The Commission lists the following priorities: improved coherence between the various goals pursued by the GFP, especially between resource conservation, economic viability, and job security in fishing-dependent areas; stronger consideration of the economic dimension of the fisheries sector; improved integration of environmental and fisheries policies; better management tools, particularly the inclusion of multi-year management objectives; a more transparent decision-making process; and the maintenance of the external dimension of the GFP.
lsp.reference: The Commission lists the following priorities: improved coherence between the various objectives pursued by the GFP, in particular between the conservation of resources, economic viability and job security in the fishing-dependent areas; stronger consideration of the economic dimension of the fishing sector; improved integration of environmental and fisheries policy; improvement of management instruments, in particular the inclusion of multiannual management objectives; a more transparent decision-making process and the preservation of the external dimension of the GFP.

lsp.query: Bis zum 31. Dezember 2002 bleiben uns noch zwei Jahre, in denen wir über eine gemeinsame Politik nachdenken und beschließen können. Laut Aufstellung der Europäischen Kommission stellen sich in diesem Zusammenhang 18 Fragen, wie freier oder nicht freier Zugang zu den Gemeinschaftsgewässern, Kontrolle oder Management des Marktes für Fischerei- und Aquakulturerzeugnisse, internationale Fischereiabkommen, wissenschaftliche Forschungstätigkeit in Bezug auf die Fischbestände, Besonderheiten des Mittelmeerraums.
lsp.judge: Until December 31, 2002, we still have two years to think about and decide on a common policy. According to the European Commission's list, 18 questions arise in this context, such as free or non-free access to community waters, control or management of the market for fisheries and aquaculture products, international fisheries agreements, scientific research activities related to fish stocks, and specificities of the Mediterranean region.
lsp.proxy: By December 31, 2002, we still have two years left to think about and decide on a common policy. According to the European Commission's list, this involves 18 questions, such as free or non-free access to community waters, control or management of the market for fishery and aquaculture products, international fishing agreements, scientific research activities concerning fish stocks, and special aspects of the Mediterranean region.
lsp.reference: Until December 31, 2002, we still have two years to think about and decide on a common policy. According to the list of the European Commission, 18 questions arise in this context, such as free or non-free access to community waters, control or management of the market for fishery and aquaculture products, international fishing agreements, scientific research on fish stocks, special features of the Mediterranean.

lsp.query: Das Europäische Parlament hat sich natürlich konsequent gegenüber sich selbst verhalten, denn - wie der Kriegsverbrecher und ehemalige NATO-Generalsekretär sowie jetzige Hohe Vertreter der EU, Javier Solana, in zynischen Worten in seiner Ansprache hervorhob - das Europäische Parlament hat selbst beharrlich die militärische Intervention auf dem Balkan, sowohl in Bosnien als auch im Kosovo, gefordert.
lsp.judge: The European Parliament has, of course, consistently acted in accordance with itself, for - as the war criminal and former NATO Secretary General and current High Representative of the EU, Javier Solana, cynically pointed out in his speech - the European Parliament has persistently demanded military intervention in the Balkans, both in Bosnia and in Kosovo.
lsp.proxy: The European Parliament has, of course, consistently held itself to this standard, as the war criminal and former NATO Secretary-General, currently the High Representative of the EU, Javier Solana, emphasized in his cynical words during his speech: the European Parliament itself persistently called for military intervention on the Balkans, both in Bosnia and Kosovo.
lsp.reference: The European Parliament has, of course, consistently behaved towards itself, because - as the war criminal and former NATO Secretary-General and now High Representative of the EU, Javier Solana, pointed out in his speech in cynical words - the European Parliament has consistently demanded military intervention on the Balkans, both in Bosnia and in Kosovo.

lsp.query: . (FR) Dass den Armeen der größten Mächte seit zehn Jahren die Schädlichkeit von Munition mit abgereichertem Uran, auch für diejenigen, die sie einsetzen, bekannt ist, beweist nur, dass die Generalstäbe ihren eigenen Soldaten die gleiche Missachtung entgegenbringen wie der Zivilbevölkerung und den gegnerischen Streitkräften.
lsp.judge: . (FR) The fact that the armies of the greatest powers have known for ten years about the harmfulness of ammunition with depleted uranium, even for those who use it, only proves that the general staffs show the same contempt for their own soldiers as for the civilian population and the opposing armed forces.
lsp.proxy: The fact that the armies of the great powers have known for ten years about the harmfulness of ammunition containing depleted uranium, not just for those who use it, proves that the general staffs treat their own soldiers with the same disregard as they do the civilian population and the opposing forces.

lsp.query: Seit Beginn des Atomzeitalters mit dem Zweiten Weltkrieg sind die Gefahren und Vorsorgemaßnahmen wohl bekannt, die man beim Umgang mit Uran und anderen radioaktiven Stoffen beachten muss, weil es sich um ein hochtoxisches (chemisch und radiologisch toxisches) Element handelt, wenn man es einatmet oder aufnimmt, das auch genetisch gefährlich ist.
lsp.judge: Since the beginning of the atomic age with the Second World War, the dangers and precautions that must be taken when dealing with uranium and other radioactive substances are well known, as it is a highly toxic (chemically and radiologically toxic) element if inhaled or ingested, and is also genetically dangerous.
lsp.proxy: Since the beginning of the atomic age, starting with World War II, the dangers and precautionary measures that must be observed when handling uranium and other radioactive substances are well known, as it is a highly toxic (chemically and radiologically toxic) element that can be hazardous to genetic material if inhaled or ingested.
lsp.reference: Since the beginning of the atomic age with World War II, the dangers and precautions to be observed when handling uranium and other radioactive substances are well known, because it is a highly toxic (chemically and radiologically toxic) element if it is inhaled or ingested, which is also genetically dangerous.

lsp.query: Der Einsatz dieses Waffentyps durch die Vereinigten Staaten und andere NATO-Länder während des Golfkriegs, in Bosnien und im Kosovo hat bereits den Tod vieler Soldaten, Leiden und Todesfälle bei den Bewohnern der bombardierten Gebiete und die Verseuchung der Umwelt in den betroffenen Regionen verursacht.
lsp.judge: The use of this type of weapon by the United States and other NATO countries during the Gulf War, in Bosnia, and in Kosovo has already caused the death of many soldiers, suffering, and fatalities among the residents of the bombed areas, and the pollution of the environment in the affected regions.
lsp.proxy: The deployment of this type of weapon by the United States and other NATO countries during the Gulf War, in Bosnia, and in Kosovo has already caused the deaths of many soldiers, suffering and fatalities among the inhabitants of the bombed areas, and environmental pollution in the affected regions.
lsp.reference: The use of this type of weapon by the United States and other NATO countries during the Gulf War, in Bosnia and Kosovo has already caused the death of many soldiers, suffering and deaths among the residents of the bombed areas and the pollution of the environment in the affected regions.

lsp.query: Herr Präsident, nach all den tragischen Geschehnissen im Zusammenhang mit der Bombardierung Jugoslawiens und nach den Enthüllungen über die Verwendung von Munition mit abgereichertem Uran ist es nunmehr dringend erforderlich, diese Art von Waffen zu verbieten, die selbst nach ihrem Einsatz noch über eine lange Zeit hinweg gefährliche Auswirkungen haben und blind, d. h. ohne erkennbaren Unterschied, all diejenigen treffen können, die Gefahr laufen, mit ihnen in Berührung zu kommen.
lsp.judge: Mr. President, after all the tragic events related to the bombing of Yugoslavia and the revelations about the use of depleted uranium ammunition, it is now urgently necessary to ban this type of weapon, which can have dangerous effects for a long time after its use and can blindly, i.e. without any discernible difference, affect all those who are at risk of coming into contact with it.
lsp.proxy: Mr. President, following all the tragic events in connection with the bombing of Yugoslavia and the revelations about the use of munitions with depleted uranium, it is now urgently necessary to ban this type of weapon, which continues to have dangerous effects for a long time after its use and can affect indiscriminately, that is, without any discernible distinction, all those who are at risk of coming into contact with them.
lsp.reference: Mr. President, after all the tragic events in connection with the bombing of Yugoslavia and the revelations about the use of depleted uranium ammunition, it is now urgently necessary to ban this type of weapon, which can have dangerous effects for a long time even after their use and can hit all those who run the risk of coming into contact with them, blind, that is, without any discernible difference.

lsp.query: Ebenso wichtig und dringlich ist es, eine umfassende Politik der Hilfe, der Prävention und der Sanierung für all die Gebiete in Jugoslawien zu konzipieren, die unter den Folgen des Einsatzes dieser Geschosse zu leiden haben, um so die Volksgesundheit und die Umwelt schützen, Böden und Gewässer sanieren und eine stetige wirtschaftliche Entwicklung des Landes und der gesamten Region gewährleisten zu können.
lsp.judge: It is equally important and urgent to conceive a comprehensive policy of assistance, prevention, and rehabilitation for all the areas in Yugoslavia that are suffering from the consequences of the use of these projectiles, in order to protect public health and the environment, rehabilitate soils and waters, and ensure a steady economic development of the country and the entire region.
lsp.proxy: It is equally important and urgent to design a comprehensive policy of aid, prevention, and rehabilitation for all areas in Yugoslavia that suffer from the consequences of the use of these munitions, thereby protecting public health and the environment, rehabilitating soils and water bodies, and ensuring continuous economic development of the country and the entire region.
lsp.reference: Similarly important and urgent is to design a comprehensive policy of assistance, prevention and rehabilitation for all the areas in Yugoslavia that are suffering from the consequences of the use of these projectiles, in order to protect public health and the environment, to clean up the soil and water, and to ensure a continuous economic development of the country and the entire region.

lsp.query: Abschließend möchte ich meine Ratlosigkeit angesichts der politischen Kehrtwende zum Ausdruck bringen, die bei unserer Aussprache zutage getreten ist. Während uns seinerzeit einige vorhielten, unsere Kritik an Milosevics Politik diene der NATO und ihren Bombardements, wirft uns Herr Solana heute vor, wir würden bei unseren Vorbehalten gegenüber dem abgereicherten Uran die Menschenrechte der Opfer von Milosevic vergessen.
lsp.judge: Finally, I would like to express my bewilderment at the political about-face that has emerged during our debate. While some accused us in the past of our criticism of Milosevic's policy serving NATO and their bombings, Mr. Solana now accuses us of forgetting the human rights of the victims of Milosevic when we express our reservations about depleted uranium.
lsp.proxy: In conclusion, I want to express my helplessness regarding the political about-face that has become apparent during our discussion. While some had previously argued that our criticism of Milosevic's politics served the NATO and their bombings, Mr. Solana now accuses us of forgetting the human rights of the victims of Milosevic when we harbor reservations about depleted uranium.
lsp.reference: In conclusion, I would like to express my bewilderment at the political U-turn that has emerged during our discussion. While some of us were once criticized for our criticism of Milosevic's policy, which served the NATO and their bombings, Mr. Solana accuses us today of forgetting the human rights of the victims of Milosevic by our reservations about the depleted uranium.

lsp.query: Wir fordern die EU außerdem auf, die UN-Hochkommissarin für Menschenrechte sowie die anderen internationalen Organisationen und die NRO im Kampf gegen die Unterdrückung unabhängiger Medien - ein Punkt, den Lord Bethell bereits angesprochen hat - sowie von Journalisten und Schriftstellern zu unterstützen und alle Staaten dazu anzuhalten, die Zensur abzuschaffen, das Recht auf Zugang zu offiziellen Informationen zu schützen und die Einschränkungen beim Zugang zur modernen Informationstechnologie aufzuheben, die oft die Rettung für unterdrückte Menschen ist.
lsp.judge: We also call on the EU to support the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights, as well as other international organizations and NGOs in the fight against the suppression of independent media - a point that Lord Bethell has already addressed - as well as journalists and writers, and to urge all states to abolish censorship, protect the right to access official information, and lift restrictions on access to modern information technology, which is often the salvation for oppressed people.
lsp.proxy: We also urge the EU to support the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights as well as other international organizations and civil society organizations (CSOs) in the fight against the suppression of independent media - a point that Lord Bethell has already addressed - and to support journalists and writers, and to encourage all states to abolish censorship, protect the right to access official information, and lift restrictions on access to modern information technology, which often serves as a lifeline for oppressed people.
lsp.reference: We also call on the EU to support the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights and other international organizations and NROs in the fight against the suppression of independent media - a point that Lord Bethell has already touched on - as well as to support journalists and writers and urge all states to abolish censorship, protect the right to access official information, and lift restrictions on access to modern information technology, which is often the salvation for oppressed people.

lsp.query: Herr Präsident, Herr Vitorino, Herr Ratspräsident, wenn wir eine Entscheidung über ein Thema wie die Menschenrechte treffen sollen, haben wir zwei Möglichkeiten: Wir können Prinzipien nennen und auf die Benennung von Gebieten verzichten, oder wir können so vorgehen, wie wir es getan haben, nämlich Gebiete benennen und dabei das Risiko eingehen, dass man einige vergisst.
lsp.judge: Mr. President, Mr. Vitorino, Mr. President of the Council, if we are to make a decision on a topic like human rights, we have two options: We can name principles and avoid naming areas, or we can proceed as we have done, namely naming areas and taking the risk that some may be forgotten.
lsp.proxy: Mr. President, Mr. Vitorino, Mr. Council President, if we are to make a decision on a topic like human rights, we have two options: We can name principles and avoid naming areas, or we can proceed as we have done, namely by naming areas and thereby taking the risk that some will be forgotten.
lsp.reference: Mr. President, Mr. Vitorino, Mr. Council President, if we are to make a decision on a matter like human rights, we have two options: We can name principles and avoid naming areas, or we can proceed as we have done, namely to name areas and take the risk that some will be forgotten.

lsp.query: (Beifall) Zweitens: Wir fordern Sie auf, schon ziemlich schnell - die Vorbereitungen müssen unter Ihrer Präsidentschaft beginnen und sollten dann in Laken unter belgischer Präsidentschaft zu einem Beschluss führen - eine Konferenz einzusetzen, die sich an der Methodik und an dem Modell des Konventes orientiert, unter starker Beteiligung des Europäischen Parlaments und natürlich der nationalen Regierungen, vor allen Dingen aber auch der Kommission.
lsp.judge: (Applause) Secondly: We call on you to start preparations quite soon - they should begin under your presidency and lead to a decision under Belgian presidency in Laken - to convene a conference that is oriented towards the methodology and model of the Convention, with strong participation of the European Parliament and, of course, the national governments, but above all also the Commission.
lsp.proxy: (Applause) Second: We urge you to start making preparations quite swiftly – these must begin under your presidency and should then lead to a decision in Laeken under the Belgian presidency – by convening a conference that is oriented towards the method and model of the Convention, with strong involvement of the European Parliament and, of course, the national governments, but especially also of the Commission.
lsp.reference: (Applause) Secondly: We call on you to start preparing this as soon as possible - the preparations must begin under your presidency and should then lead to a decision in Luxembourg under Belgian presidency - to set up a conference that is oriented towards the method and model of the convention, with strong involvement of the European Parliament and of course the national governments, but above all also of the Commission.

lsp.query: Es gibt einen anderen Tippfehler: Tschechien und Ungarn, die die gleiche Bevölkerungszahl haben wie Belgien und Portugal, sollen nur 20 Europaabgeordnete haben, die anderen beiden Länder 22. Geben wir auch Tschechien und Ungarn 22 Abgeordnete im Europäischen Parlament und beginnen wir die Erweiterung nicht mit einer Diskriminierung dieser beiden Länder!
lsp.judge: There is another typo: Czech Republic and Hungary, which have the same population as Belgium and Portugal, should only have 20 MEPs, while the other two countries have 22. Let's also give Czech Republic and Hungary 22 MEPs in the European Parliament and not start the expansion with discrimination against these two countries!
lsp.proxy: There is another typo: Czech Republic and Hungary, which have the same population as Belgium and Portugal, are supposed to have only 20 European Parliament members, while the other two countries get 22. Let's also give Czech Republic and Hungary 22 Members of the European Parliament and start the expansion without discriminating against these two countries!
lsp.reference: There is another mistake: Czech Republic and Hungary, which have the same population as Belgium and Portugal, should only have 20 European deputies, the other two countries 22. Let's also give Czech Republic and Hungary 22 deputies in the European Parliament and start the expansion without discriminating against these two countries!

lsp.query: Wir sehen mit großer Sorge, dass es, auch durch das Handeln des Generalsekretariats des Ministerrats - und Herr Solana, den ich hoch schätze, kümmert sich ja mehr um die Aufgabe des Hohen Vertreters - an der Spitze des Generalsekretariats des Ministerrats manche Abschottungen gibt, dass man weder der Kommission noch dem Europäischen Parlament Informationen geben will.
lsp.judge: We are greatly concerned to see that, also through the actions of the General Secretariat of the Council of Ministers - and Mr. Solana, whom I highly respect, is more concerned with the task of the High Representative - at the top of the General Secretariat of the Council of Ministers, there are some closures, and they do not want to provide information to either the Commission or the European Parliament.
lsp.proxy: We see with great concern that, despite the actions of the General Secretariat of the Council - and I highly esteem Mr. Solana, who indeed takes more interest in the task of the High Representative - there are some isolations at the top of the General Secretariat of the Council, where neither the Commission nor the European Parliament is willing to share information.
lsp.reference: We see with great concern that, even through the actions of the Secretary-General of the Council of Ministers - and Mr. Solana, whom I highly esteem, is more concerned about the task of the High Representative - there are some barriers at the top of the Secretary-General of the Council of Ministers, that neither the Commission nor the European Parliament wants to give information.

lsp.query: Schweden übernimmt zum ersten Mal den Ratsvorsitz und hat seine Prioritäten gesetzt, die berühmten 3 "E ", die mit dem Manifest der europäischen Sozialisten und Sozialdemokraten übereinstimmen, weil ich stolz sagen kann, dass Herr Persson und seine Partei zu meiner politischen Familie gehören, und der Ministerpräsident Schwedens hier darüber hinaus eine Verteidigung des europäischen Sozialmodells und seiner Anpassungsfähigkeit in Zeiten der Globalisierung vorgenommen hat, die uns mit Stolz erfüllt.
lsp.judge: Sweden is taking over the presidency of the Council for the first time and has set its priorities, the famous 3 "E"s, which align with the manifesto of the European Socialists and Social Democrats, because I can proudly say that Mr. Persson and his party belong to my political family, and the Prime Minister of Sweden has here defended the European social model and its adaptability in times of globalization, which fills us with pride.
lsp.proxy: Sweden is taking on the presidency for the first time and has set its priorities, which align with the famous 3 "E's" from the Manifesto of European Socialists and Social Democrats, because I can proudly say that Mr. Persson and his party belong to my political family, and the Swedish Prime Minister has also defended the European social model and its adaptability in times of globalization, which fills us with pride.
lsp.reference: Sweden takes over the presidency for the first time and has set its priorities, the famous 3 "E", which coincide with the Manifesto of the European Socialists and Social Democrats, because I can proudly say that Mr. Persson and his party belong to my political family, and the Prime Minister of Sweden has also made a defense of the European social model and its adaptability in times of globalization, which fills us with pride.

lsp.query: Wenn Sie, Herr Präsident, daher etwas Mitgefühl unter Beweis stellen und Ihre Kollegen im Rat bewegen könnten, diese Konferenz auf 2003 vorzuziehen oder auf 2005 zu verschieben, würde damit vielleicht die Ehre dieses Parlaments gerettet, das vielfach nicht genau weiß, was dieses Wort bedeutet.
lsp.judge: Therefore, if you, Mr. President, could demonstrate some compassion and persuade your colleagues in the Council to move this conference to 2003 or postpone it to 2005, perhaps the honor of this Parliament, which often does not know exactly what this word means, could be saved.
lsp.proxy: If, Mr. President, you could therefore show some empathy and persuade your colleagues in the Council to prioritize this conference for 2003 or postpone it until 2005, perhaps it would save the honor of this Parliament, which often does not quite know what that word means.

lsp.query: In einer ersten Phase müsste parallel zu der unter schwedischer Präsidentschaft begonnenen Diskussion auf Einladung des Europäischen Rates - und zwar frühestmöglich - eine Diskussion und Meinungsbildung auf der Ebene der nationalen Parlamente stattfinden, die dann ebenso wie das Europäische Parlament jeweils bis etwa Frühjahr 2002 einen Vorschlag hinsichtlich dieser Kompetenzabgrenzung vorlegen müssten.
lsp.judge: In a first phase, parallel to the discussion initiated under the Swedish presidency, a discussion and opinion formation at the level of national parliaments should take place as soon as possible, upon invitation of the European Council, and both the national parliaments and the European Parliament would have to submit a proposal regarding this delimitation of competences by about spring 2002.
lsp.proxy: In the first phase, parallel to the discussion initiated by the Swedish Presidency at the invitation of the European Council - and as soon as possible - a discussion and opinion-forming process should take place at the level of national parliaments, which would then, like the European Parliament, have to present proposals regarding this competence delimitation by early spring 2002.
lsp.reference: In a first phase, a discussion and opinion formation at the level of national parliaments should take place in parallel to the discussion initiated by the Swedish presidency - and as soon as possible - which would then, like the European Parliament, each submit a proposal on this competence delimitation by about spring 2002.

lsp.query: Erst auf dieser Grundlage sollte ein Konvent unter Beteiligung von Verfassungsexperten, Europarechtsexperten, Vertretern der nationalen Parlamente, des Europäischen Parlaments, nationaler Regierungen, aber auch der Regierungen der Beitrittsländer und natürlich des Gerichtshofs und der Zivilgesellschaft einberufen und mit der Erstellung eines Vorschlages für einen Katalog beauftragt werden, und zwar etwa bis Frühjahr 2003.
lsp.judge: Only on this basis should a convention be convened, involving constitutional experts, European law experts, representatives of national parliaments, the European Parliament, national governments, but also the governments of the accession countries and, of course, the Court of Justice and civil society, and be tasked with drafting a proposal for a catalog, approximately by spring 2003.
lsp.proxy: Only on this basis should a convention be convened, involving constitutional experts, European law experts, representatives of national parliaments, the European Parliament, national governments, as well as governments of candidate countries, and naturally the Court and civil society, and tasked with drafting a proposal for a charter, and this should ideally take place by early 2003.

lsp.query: Beim Thema Erweiterung schließlich sehen wir das Wichtigste nicht lediglich in der Übernahme des materiellen gemeinschaftlichen Besitzstandes, sondern fordern, dass der Schwerpunkt auf den ethischen Acquis Communautaire gelegt wird, d. h. an erster Stelle auf Demokratie, Achtung der Menschenrechte und der Minderheiten, damit Europa wirklich eine Wertegemeinschaft, kurzum eine Gemeinschaft darstellen kann.
lsp.judge: Finally, on the topic of enlargement, we do not see the most important aspect solely in the adoption of the material acquis communautaire, but demand that the focus be placed on the ethical acquis communautaire, i.e., first and foremost on democracy, respect for human rights and minorities, so that Europe can truly represent a community of values, in short, a community.
lsp.proxy: Finally, when it comes to extension, we see the most important aspect not just in the adoption of the material common heritage, but rather call for the focus to be placed on the ethical Acquis Communautaire, that is, first and foremost on democracy, respect for human rights and minorities, so that Europe can truly be a community of values, in short, a community.
lsp.reference: Finally, on the subject of expansion, we see the most important thing not just in the takeover of the material common property, but we demand that the emphasis be placed on the ethical Acquis Communautaire, i.e. first and foremost on democracy, respect for human rights and minorities, so that Europe can really be a community of values, in short, a community.

lsp.query: Ebenso wie einige andere Redner des heutigen Tages bin auch ich beunruhigt über die Tendenz, das zwischenstaatliche Modell oft und nachdrücklich auf Kosten des so genannten Community Approach hervorzuheben, der der Kommission eine stärkere Rolle und Bedeutung zuweist.
lsp.judge: Like some other speakers today, I am also concerned about the tendency to often and emphatically highlight the intergovernmental model at the expense of the so-called Community Approach, which assigns a stronger role and significance to the Commission.
lsp.proxy: Similarly to some other speakers today, I am also concerned about the tendency to often and emphatically highlight the intergovernmental model at the expense of what is known as the Community Approach, which assigns the Commission a stronger role and significance.
lsp.reference: Like some other speakers today, I am also concerned about the tendency to often and emphatically highlight the inter-state model at the expense of the so-called Community Approach, which gives the Commission a stronger role and significance.

lsp.query: Wenn es Ihnen gelingt, Ihre Landsleute davon zu überzeugen, dass der Euro ein gutes Projekt ist, dass er nach innen stabil ist, dass seine Stabilität nach außen auch immer besser wird, wenn Sie sie davon überzeugen können, dieses große Werk der europäischen Integration mitzutragen, tragen Sie damit auch dazu bei, dass dieser Bereich der Europäischen Union auch von den Bürgern besser verstanden werden kann.
lsp.judge: If you manage to convince your fellow citizens that the euro is a good project, that it is stable internally, that its stability is also improving externally, and if you can convince them to contribute to this great work of European integration, you are also contributing to making this area of the European Union better understood by citizens.
lsp.proxy: If you manage to convince your fellow citizens that the Euro is a good project, that it is stable internally, and that its stability is getting better externally over time, and if you can persuade them to contribute to this great work of European integration, then you will also help to ensure that this area of the European Union is better understood by its citizens.
lsp.reference: If you can convince your fellow citizens that the euro is a good project, that it is stable internally, and that its stability is also getting better externally, if you can convince them to contribute to this great work of European integration, you will also contribute to the fact that this area of the European Union is better understood by the citizens.

lsp.query: Was die in Genf ansässige UN-Kommission zur Durchsetzung von Entschädigungsforderungen betrifft, die ja seit Beendigung des Golfkrieges mit der Begleichung von aus diesem Krieg stammenden Forderungen beschäftigt ist, so halte ich es für klug, eine Untersuchung der UNO über eine Fortsetzung der Arbeit dieser Kommission abzuwarten, ehe die Union dazu Stellung nimmt.

lsp.query: Ich weise Sie darauf hin, dass die Sicherheit das A und O des Luftverkehrs ist, wobei zu beachten ist, dass diese Sicherheit auf zwei Faktoren beruht: zum einen auf dem technischen Faktor, das heißt den Ausrüstungen, Flugzeugen, Flughäfen, Funknavigations- und Flugleiteinrichtungen usw., und zum anderen auf dem äußerst bedeutsamen menschlichen Faktor, der zwar keinen entscheidenden, aber doch einen sehr hohen Anteil an den Flugzeugunglücken hat.
lsp.judge: I would like to point out that safety is the be-all and end-all of air traffic, noting that this safety is based on two factors: on the one hand, the technical factor, that is, the equipment, aircraft, airports, radio navigation and air traffic control facilities, etc., and on the other hand, the extremely important human factor, which, although not decisive, does have a very high share in aircraft accidents.
lsp.proxy: I draw your attention to the fact that safety is the paramount concern in air traffic, with two factors being crucial for this safety: on one hand, the technical factor, which includes equipment, aircraft, airports, radio navigation and control facilities, etc., and on the other hand, the extremely important human factor, which, although not decisive, still plays a very high role in aircraft accidents.

lsp.query: Meines Erachtens wird hierdurch deutlich, dass die Verkehrssicherheit nicht mit herausgegriffenen Einzelmaßnahmen im erforderlichen Maße erhöht werden kann, sondern dass dies nur durch einen ganzen Komplex von Maßnahmen machbar ist, und dazu gehören Verkehrserziehung, Geschwindigkeitsbegrenzung, Alkoholbegrenzung, besserer Straßenausbau, Verkehrsleitsysteme, erhöhter Sicherheitsstandard der Fahrzeuge, stärkere Kontrollen der Einhaltung der Straßenverkehrsordnung und auch eine permanente Begutachtung der Fahrzeuge, die sich im Straßenverkehr befinden.
lsp.judge: In my opinion, this clearly shows that traffic safety cannot be significantly increased by isolated measures, but that this can only be achieved through a whole complex of measures, and these include traffic education, speed limits, alcohol limits, better road construction, traffic guidance systems, increased safety standards for vehicles, stronger controls on compliance with traffic regulations, and also a permanent assessment of the vehicles that are on the road.
lsp.proxy: In my opinion, it becomes clear here that traffic safety cannot be increased sufficiently through makeshift individual measures alone, but can only be achieved through a comprehensive range of measures, which include traffic education, speed limits, alcohol limits, better road infrastructure, traffic control systems, higher vehicle safety standards, stronger enforcement of traffic regulations, and also continuous inspection of vehicles in circulation.
lsp.reference: In my opinion, it becomes clear here that traffic safety cannot be increased to the required extent with individual measures, but that this can only be achieved through a whole range of measures, and this includes traffic education, speed limits, alcohol limits, better road construction, traffic control systems, higher safety standards for vehicles, stronger enforcement of the Road Traffic Act and also a permanent inspection of vehicles in traffic.

lsp.query: Schließlich kennzeichnet eine Reihe von Hindernissen, verursacht durch mangelnde Harmonisierung der Fristen und Zeitpläne zwischen den einzelnen Verkehrsträgern, das gesamte System, wodurch es zu Unvereinbarkeiten zwischen den mit der Gütertransportkette verknüpften Erfordernissen und den operativen Erfordernissen der im Prozess eingesetzten Ressourcen kommt: So sind beispielsweise die Arbeitszeiten der Fahrer und Besatzungen nicht auf die intermodalen Operationen abgestimmt und die Terminals können sich nicht immer den auf einem 24-Stunden-Dienst beruhenden Zug- und Schiffsplänen anpassen.

lsp.query: In ihrem Bericht "Intermodalität und intermodaler Güterverkehr in der Europäischen Union " hatte die Kommission die im intermodalen Verkehr zu erreichenden Ziele aufgezeigt und sie entsprechend der spezifischen Probleme in drei vorrangige Interventionsbereiche, so genannte Schlüsselaktionen unterteilt. Die erste Schlüsselaktion betrifft die Integration von Infrastruktur und Transportmitteln, die zweite die Interoperabilität und den Verbundbetrieb und die dritte die verkehrsträgerunabhängigen Dienste und Vorschriften.
lsp.judge: In its report "Intermodality and intermodal freight transport in the European Union," the Commission had outlined the objectives to be achieved in intermodal transport and divided them into three priority intervention areas, known as key actions, according to the specific problems. The first key action concerns the integration of infrastructure and means of transport, the second concerns interoperability and combined operation, and the third concerns transport-independent services and regulations.

lsp.query: Wenn mir ein gewisser Vergleich mit der Diskussion erlaubt ist, die vor dem Hintergrund der Probleme im Zusammenhang mit der Nahrungsmittelsicherheit über die Reform der Agrarpolitik gegenwärtig nicht nur in Deutschland, sondern auch in einigen weiteren Mitgliedstaaten - mein Land zählt dazu - geführt wird, so prophezeie ich Ihnen angesichts der heutigen Umweltprobleme - trotz gescheiterter Klimakonferenzen - eine ähnliche Situation auch im Bereich der Verkehrspolitik.
lsp.judge: If I may be allowed a certain comparison with the discussion that is currently taking place not only in Germany but also in some other member states - my country is included - against the background of the problems related to food safety regarding the reform of agricultural policy, I predict a similar situation in the field of transport policy in view of the current environmental problems - despite failed climate conferences.
lsp.proxy: If a comparison with the current discussion on reforming agricultural policy against the background of food security issues, which is not only taking place in Germany but also in several other member states - my country included - is allowed, then I foresee a similar situation in transport policy given today's environmental problems, despite failed climate conferences.

lsp.query: Dabei erwarten wir nicht, sie würden einhellige Zustimmung finden, vielmehr soll vor allem der Kommission signalisiert werden, wie notwendig es ist, in Bälde eine gewisse Koordinierung, wenn nicht gar Harmonisierung dieser Maßnahmen, zu denen unter anderem die kilometerabhängige Schwerverkehrsabgabe zählt, auf europäischer Ebene vorzunehmen, um zu verhindern, dass sie zwar in dem einen, nicht aber in dem anderen Land angewandt werden, dass das eine Land erklärt, die Kosten seien wissenschaftlich nicht berechenbar, während in dem anderen Land die Berechnung ohne weiteres möglich ist, was selbstverständlich eine völlig groteske Situation wäre.
lsp.judge: We do not expect them to find unanimous approval, rather, it should primarily signal to the Commission how necessary it is to soon undertake a certain coordination, if not harmonization, of these measures, which include the kilometer-dependent heavy traffic charge, at the European level, in order to prevent them from being applied in one country but not in another, that one country declares the costs to be scientifically incalculable, while in another country the calculation is possible without further ado, which would of course be a completely grotesque situation.
lsp.proxy: We do not expect uniform approval, but rather aim to signal to the Commission how urgent it is to soon coordinate, if not harmonize, these measures, including the kilometer-dependent heavy traffic charge, at the European level, to prevent them from being applied in one country but not in another, where one country declares that the costs cannot be scientifically calculated, while in another country the calculation can be done without any difficulty, which would of course be a completely absurd situation.

lsp.query: Um es nicht dazu kommen zu lassen, darf unser Ziel nicht darin bestehen, die Verkehrsinfrastrukturkosten zu minimieren, um somit möglichst wenig Kosten anzulasten, sondern wir müssen den Verkehrsbetreibern eine entsprechende Rechtsgrundlage bieten, damit sie die verursachten Kosten der Gruppe anlasten können, die dafür aufzukommen haben, nämlich den Endnutzern.
lsp.judge: To prevent this from happening, our goal should not be to minimize the costs of the transport infrastructure in order to charge as little as possible, but rather to provide transport operators with an appropriate legal basis so that they can charge the costs incurred to the group that is responsible for them, namely the end users.
lsp.proxy: To prevent this from happening, our goal must not be to minimize traffic infrastructure costs in order to shift as little cost as possible, but we must provide traffic operators with the appropriate legal basis so that they can pass on the costs incurred to the group responsible for bearing them, namely the end users.
lsp.reference: To prevent this from happening, our goal should not be to minimize transportation infrastructure costs in order to minimize costs as much as possible, but rather we must provide transportation operators with the necessary legal basis so that they can pass on the costs incurred by the group to the end users who are responsible for them.

lsp.query: Folglich hat die Kommission die stufenweise Einführung - ich bedauere, dass Herr Izquierdo gegangen ist, denn so hat er nicht gesehen, dass Herr Costa diesen Änderungsantrag akzeptiert hat und die Kommission damit auch zufrieden ist - eines harmonisierten Rahmens zur Erhebung von Infrastrukturgebühren in der Europäischen Union vorgeschlagen, die auf alle Verkehrsmittel anwendbar ist.
lsp.judge: Consequently, the Commission has proposed the gradual introduction - I regret that Mr. Izquierdo has left, because he did not see that Mr. Costa accepted this amendment and the Commission is also satisfied with it - of a harmonized framework for the collection of infrastructure charges in the European Union, which is applicable to all modes of transport.

lsp.query: Heute befinden sich die Beschäftigten des Unternehmens, zumindest in Frankreich, im Streik, und ich möchte in Erwartung Ihrer Antwort hinsichtlich des Ausschusses diesen Arbeitnehmern unsere Solidarität bekunden, denn es ist eine Schande, dass ein Konzern, der Milliarden Gewinne macht, Tausende von Arbeitnehmern in ganz Europa in die Arbeitslosigkeit und ins Elend schickt.
lsp.judge: Today, the employees of the company, at least in France, are on strike, and I would like to express our solidarity with these workers in anticipation of your response regarding the committee, because it is a shame that a corporation making billions in profits is sending thousands of workers into unemployment and poverty across Europe.

lsp.query: Deshalb sollte sich das Präsidium mit dieser wichtigen Angelegenheit befassen, und ich möchte anfragen, ob es darüber informiert ist und ob es bei den Straßburger Behörden wegen zusätzlicher Maßnahmen zum Schutz des Parlaments vorstellig geworden ist. Wenn ich es richtig sehe, hat fast jedermann Zutritt zum Parlament, und ich befürchte, wir haben uns auf überaus gefährliche und unvorhersehbare Ereignisse einzustellen.
lsp.judge: Therefore, the presidency should deal with this important matter, and I would like to ask whether it is informed and whether it has approached the Strasbourg authorities for additional measures to protect the Parliament. If I am correct, almost everyone has access to the Parliament, and I fear that we must prepare for extremely dangerous and unpredictable events.

lsp.query: In diesen Berichten wiederholen wir uns ständig. Wir fordern bessere Statistiken und Ausbildung, Aufklärungskampagnen, um mehr Frauen für die Politik zu interessieren, so wie sie bereits sehr oft in ihren eigenen Gemeinden und örtlichen Gruppen eine wichtige Rolle spielen, und wir fordern Maßnahmen, damit Männer und Frauen Arbeit und Familie besser in Einklang bringen können.
lsp.judge: In these reports, we constantly repeat ourselves. We demand better statistics and training, awareness campaigns to interest more women in politics, as they already play an important role in their own communities and local groups, and we demand measures to help men and women better balance work and family.

lsp.query: Die Wirklichkeit zeigt jedoch, dass dies ungeachtet der mannigfachen Empfehlungen und Entschließungen ein Bereich ist, in dem nach wie vor größere Ungleichgewichte herrschen und Frauen in den politischen Entscheidungsgremien - sowohl im wirtschaftlichen und sozialen als auch im politischen Leben - erheblich unterrepräsentiert sind. Dies wiederum trägt dazu bei, dass die vorhandenen Ungleichheiten und Diskriminierungen weiter bestehen.
lsp.judge: However, reality shows that despite numerous recommendations and resolutions, this is an area where significant imbalances still exist and women are significantly underrepresented in political decision-making bodies - both in economic and social as well as political life. This, in turn, contributes to the persistence of existing inequalities and discrimination.

lsp.query: Dies bedeutet auch, dass Männer und Frauen in Bereichen des öffentlichen und privaten Lebens die gleiche Verantwortung übernehmen, um neue Praktiken gegen die Diskriminierung zu fördern, und zwar auch in den politischen Parteien und öffentlichen und privaten Verwaltungen. Das Ziel muss lauten, psychologische und praktische Hindernisse für die Mitwirkung der Frauen in den Entscheidungsgremien und im politischen Leben auszuräumen und so Rückschritten wie der kürzlichen Abschaffung des Gleichstellungsministeriums durch die Regierung in Portugal zu begegnen.
lsp.judge: This also means that men and women in areas of public and private life must take equal responsibility to promote new practices against discrimination, including in political parties and public and private administrations. The goal must be to remove psychological and practical obstacles to women's participation in decision-making bodies and political life, and to counter setbacks such as the recent abolition of the Ministry of Equality by the government in Portugal.
lsp.proxy: This also means that men and women in both public and private spheres should take on the same responsibility for promoting new practices against discrimination, including within political parties and public and private administrations. The goal must be to remove psychological and practical barriers to women's participation in decision-making bodies and political life, thereby confronting setbacks such as the recent abolition of the Ministry for Equality by the Portuguese government.

The goal must be to clear psychological and practical obstacles to women's participation in decision-making bodies and in politics and to confront setbacks such as the recent abolition of the Ministry for Equality by the Portuguese government.

lsp.query: Man sollte vielmehr die politischen Parteien auffordern, ihre Strukturen und Verfahren zu reformieren, um die unmittelbaren und mittelbaren Hindernisse für die Mitwirkung der Frauen aus dem Wege zu räumen, wobei selbstverständlich die Staaten selbst durch finanzielle Anreize die Parteien ermutigen könnten, möglichst viele Kandidatinnen auf die Wahllisten zu setzen.
lsp.judge: Rather, political parties should be urged to reform their structures and procedures to remove the immediate and indirect obstacles to women's participation, with states themselves encouraging parties through financial incentives to put as many female candidates on the electoral lists as possible.
lsp.proxy: One should rather urge political parties to reform their structures and procedures to remove the direct and indirect obstacles to women's participation, with states naturally encouraging parties through financial incentives to place as many female candidates as possible on the election lists.
lsp.reference: Instead, one should call on political parties to reform their structures and procedures to remove the immediate and indirect obstacles to women's participation, while of course states could encourage parties to put as many female candidates on the ballot lists through financial incentives.

lsp.query: Herr Präsident, ich möchte hier den Standpunkt der arbeitenden Frauen darlegen, weil diese unter allen Frauen am meisten unter der Last der sozialen Organisation zu leiden haben und weil die Arbeiterbewegung stolz darauf verweisen kann, als erste für die Anerkennung der Gleichberechtigung von Männern und Frauen eingetreten zu sein.
lsp.judge: Mr. President, I would like to present the position of working women here, because they suffer the most under the burden of social organization among all women, and because the labor movement can proudly point out that it was the first to advocate for the recognition of the equality of men and women.
lsp.proxy: Mr. President, I would like to present the standpoint of working women here, as they suffer most under the burden of social organization among all women, and because the labor movement can be proud of having been the first to advocate for the recognition of equality between men and women.
lsp.reference: Mr. President, I would like to present the position of working women here, because they suffer more than any other women under the burden of the social organization and because the labor movement can be proud to have been the first to advocate for the recognition of equality between men and women.

lsp.query: Eine dritte Kategorie von Politiken schließlich betrifft das Eingreifen der Europäischen Union und die Zusammenarbeit der Mitgliedstaaten. Es sind die politischen Netzwerke der Frauen, es sind die Indikatoren auf europäischer Ebene - erwähnt seien hier nur die finnische Präsidentschaft und ihre 9 Indikatoren, deren Anwendung zu nationalen Verpflichtungen und nationalen Zielen führen kann -, das Benchmarking-Verfahren, die Ausbildung und schlussendlich die Vorbereitung von Frauen aus den nationalen Staaten und von der politischen Bühne Europas auf eine wichtige internationale Rolle, weil so für die junge Generation Beispiele für die Macht, Beispiele für Frauenpolitiken geschaffen werden.
lsp.judge: Finally, a third category of policies concerns the intervention of the European Union and the cooperation of the Member States. These are the political networks of women, the indicators at the European level - only the Finnish presidency and its 9 indicators are mentioned here, which can lead to national commitments and national goals -, the benchmarking procedure, training, and ultimately the preparation of women from the national states and from the European political stage for an important international role, because in this way examples of power, examples of women's policies are created for the younger generation.

lsp.query: So kann ich Ihnen also ganz freimütig meine Meinung sagen: wenn eine Vertagung der Abstimmung über einen Bericht beantragt wird, der für Donnerstag Abend vorgesehen ist und von einem Abgeordneten vorgestellt werden muss, der einen Heimweg von 2000 km vor sich hat und der, wenn er den einzigen verfügbaren Flug am Donnerstag Nachmittag nicht erreicht, nicht vor Freitag Abend zu Hause sein kann, so wird man wohl auch in Zukunft flexibel in der Einschätzung seiner Lage sein können.
lsp.judge: So I can tell you quite frankly my opinion: if a postponement of the vote on a report is requested, which is scheduled for Thursday evening and must be presented by a member of parliament who has a 2000 km journey ahead of him and who, if he does not reach the only available flight on Thursday afternoon, will not be able to get home before Friday evening, then it will probably also be possible to be flexible in assessing his situation in the future.

lsp.query: Die Entschließung nennt zwar einige Länder wie Tibet, China, Afghanistan, Papua-Neuguinea oder Tschetschenien, wo die Menschenrechte in der Tat in sehr vielen, wenn nicht in allen Bereichen verletzt werden, erwähnt jedoch mit keinem Wort die Großmächte, besonders innerhalb der Europäischen Union, die die Menschenrechte vielleicht nicht zu Hause, wohl aber in ihren ehemaligen Kolonien verletzen, entweder unmittelbar oder indem sie Diktatoren protegieren, die diese Rechte mit Füßen treten.
lsp.judge: The resolution does mention some countries like Tibet, China, Afghanistan, Papua New Guinea, or Chechnya, where human rights are indeed violated in many, if not all, areas, but it does not mention the great powers, especially within the European Union, which may not violate human rights at home, but do so in their former colonies, either directly or by protecting dictators who trample on these rights.

lsp.query: - (FR) Obwohl alle einhellig die hohe Zahl von Unfällen im Straßenverkehr in den verschiedenen europäischen Mitgliedstaaten verurteilen, kann sich die EDD-Fraktion nicht vollständig mit dem Bericht von Frau Hedkvist Petersen über die Mittel, wie dem abzuhelfen ist, einverstanden erklären. Die Lösung kann nicht lauten: immer mehr Europa, immer mehr Geld, immer mehr Repression.

lsp.query: Aus diesen Gründen kann ich, obwohl ich für viele Änderungsanträge der Fraktion der Grünen/Freie Europäische Allianz, in denen konkrete Maßnahmen gefordert werden, Verständnis habe, diese hier nicht unterstützen, da sie den Konsens in den vorstehend genannten Prinzipien gefährden würden. lsp.query: Wenn der Kraftstoffpreis schwindelerregend hoch ist und das Fünf- bis Sechsfache dessen beträgt, was das Benzin beim Verlassen der Raffinerie kostet, weil er sich zu mehr als 80 % aus Steuern zusammensetzt, so kann man wohl sagen, dass der Straßennutzer, gemessen an der Nutzung seines Fahrzeugs, bereits in hohem Maße dafür zur Kasse gebeten wird, dass er öffentliche Straßeninfrastrukturen nutzt.
lsp.judge: When the fuel price is sky-high and five to six times what gasoline costs when it leaves the refinery, because it consists of more than 80% taxes, one can say that the road user, measured by the use of his vehicle, is already being asked to pay a high price for using public road infrastructure.
lsp.proxy: When the fuel price is dizzyingly high, and amounts to five to six times what gasoline costs when it leaves the refinery, because it consists of more than 80% taxes, one can say that the road user is already contributing significantly to the cost of using public road infrastructure based on the use of their vehicle.
lsp.reference: If the fuel price is dizzyingly high and is five to six times what it costs at the refinery, because it consists of more than 80% taxes, one can say that the road user, measured by the use of his vehicle, is already asked for a lot to pay for the fact that he uses public road infrastructure.

lsp.query: Herr Präsident, die Älteren unter uns haben die außergewöhnlichen, grauenhaften Berichte, die 1975 aus Kambodscha kamen, noch nicht vergessen. Es gab Luftaufnahmen von einer verlassenen Hauptstadt, weil die Roten Khmer, deren Anführer nach den Lehrsätzen der Gewalt in der Tradition der französischen Revolution geschult wurden und von einer Mischung aus politischem Idealismus und Massenpsychopathologie erfüllt waren, zwei Millionen Menschen von der Stadt auf das Land umsiedelten, um unter der Führung des "großen " Pol Pot im Jahre Null mit einer neuen Gesellschaft zu beginnen.
lsp.judge: Mr. President, the older among us have not forgotten the extraordinary, horrific reports that came out of Cambodia in 1975. There were aerial photographs of an abandoned capital city, because the Khmer Rouge, whose leaders were trained in the doctrines of violence in the tradition of the French Revolution and were filled with a mixture of political idealism and mass psychopathy, relocated two million people from the city to the countryside in order to start a new society under the leadership of the "great" Pol Pot in Year Zero.
